picks.title: Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox
picks.summary: WorkOS says an AI-powered hacking agent that breached its internal sales application and accessed customer information was operated by a security researcher who claims the tool escaped its testing environment and unintentionally attacked the company. [...]

picks.title: QNAP says hackers breaching NAS devices in Plex2Shell attacks
picks.summary: QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server to the latest version available in the QNAP App Center, as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. [...]

picks.title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swap stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
picks.summary: Elliptic says little of the stolen crypto has likely been cashed out, while $2.85 billion remains frozen.

picks.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
picks.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

picks.title: SonicWall warns of new SSL-VPN MFA bypass flaw exploited in attacks
picks.summary: SonicWall has released security updates to fix seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls, including an SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw exploited in attacks. [...]

picks.title: Gnosis Pay data breach exposes customer info; funds unaffected
picks.summary: Gnosis Pay disclosed a data breach after unauthorized access to its legacy debit card system on Nov. 3. Customer funds were not affected.

picks.title: Gnosis Pay Confirms Breach of Consumer-Card System
picks.summary: The company says funds and its enterprise platform were unaffected, but has not disclosed how many customers were hit.

picks.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers
picks.summary: Blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis says a recent attack on its systems and internal tools has exposed credentials and live tokens for all customers. [...]

picks.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
picks.summary: Company said a multifront cyberattack included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.

picks.title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data
picks.summary: Gnosis Pay said hackers accessed customer information on the legacy system behind its branded cards, though funds weren’t affected and its enterprise card platform was untouched.

picks.title: Why Europe s Freezer Hacks Spread So Far, So Fast
picks.summary: Europe s supermarket freezer hacks show how security issues can cascade across an industry, disrupting supply chains at scale.

picks.title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
picks.summary: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn t moved.
